summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Ledger (Cari), Invoice (Fatura), and Payment (Tahsilat) module. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly after fixing InvoiceDetail.js settings fetch issue.

Payment creation adds to ledger as credit and updates invoice status

Invoice stats endpoint provides collection rate and totals
